title: FCM android.priority casing: guide shows lowercase, API may require uppercase
description: The FCM urgency table shows android.priority values as lowercase high and normal. The FCM HTTP v1 API defines AndroidMessagePriority as enum values HIGH and NORMAL (uppercase). A casing mismatch will produce a 400 error or silently default to NORMAL. The correct casing needs to be verified against current FCM REST API documentation and the guide corrected accordingly.
